name: smwpatches-minimalist-course-clear
title: Minimalist Course Clear
description:
This patch lets you remove the COURSE CLEAR scorecard and/or the zooming circle effect at the end of the march.
What's removed is editable in the ASM file. However, the palette fade will always be removed.

No freespace required.

MODERATOR'S NOTES:
- It permanently disables the scorecard in Mode 7 bosses;
- If the !FreezeSprite define is disabled, the player can still walk after ending a Reznor Battle, which will likely kill him almost all the time.
